fields.name: is_invoice
fields.description: true if this email is an invoice, bill, receipt, order confirmation with a charged amount, or payment confirmation. false for newsletters, marketing and personal emails.

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: Name of the company or person that issued the invoice or receipt

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Invoice, receipt or order number. Empty if none.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Invoice or transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: currency
fields.description: 3-letter ISO currency code, e.g. PHP, USD, EUR. Use PHP for peso amounts.

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Amount before tax as a plain number. 0 if not shown.

fields.name: tax
fields.description: Tax or VAT amount as a plain number. 0 if not shown.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Final total amount charged as a plain number

fields.name: category
fields.description: Expense category, exactly one of: Software, Utilities, Travel, Food, Office Supplies, Marketing, Professional Services, Other

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One short sentence describing what was purchased

variables.name: status
variables.value: {{if(ifempty(2.information.total; 0) <= 0; "needs_review"; if(ifempty(2.information.subtotal; 0) = 0; "verified"; if(round((ifempty(2.information.subtotal; 0) + ifempty(2.information.tax; 0) - ifempty(2.information.total; 0)) * 100) > 5; "needs_review"; if(round((ifempty(2.information.subtotal; 0) + ifempty(2.information.tax; 0) - ifempty(2.information.total; 0)) * 100) < -5; "needs_review"; "verified"))))}}
